name: pam_passwdqc
detailed_description: Password quality checking module for PAM that verifies password strength and complexity. Supports passphrases and can generate random passwords. Provides flexible configuration for different password strength requirements. Available particularly on FreeBSD systems.

parameters.min: Minimum password lengths for different types
parameters.passphrase: Number of words required for passphrase
parameters.match: Length of common substring to detect reuse
parameters.random: Size of randomly-generated passwords in bits

notes:
Particularly popular on FreeBSD systems; alternative to pam_cracklib/pam_pwquality with different configuration approach.
